changeSet.author: nexus-1579m
changeSet.comment: nexus.gc_expire_quarantine_bounded: expire at most p_row_limit past-cutoff quarantine chashes per call (clamped to 5,000), in chash order, one commit and one gc_audit row per call; returns (expired, refused, more, floor_refused) so a caller can loop and terminate. RDR-222 Amendment A1. The unbounded gc_expire_quarantine is left untouched. DATA EFFECT: none -- this changeset only creates a function and grants EXECUTE on it.
changeSet.rollback: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS nexus.gc_expire_quarantine_bounded(int, text, text, text, text, float8, int, boolean, int, boolean);
